audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent from every field: Alpha Strike goes UNTARGETABLE mid-dash, Meditate is a CHANNEL, and Highlander grants immunity to all slowing effects.
audit.why: Each one changes what the reader does with a specific button. (1) Untargetable means the grenade thrown at the dive itself is wasted — you throw it where he lands. The page said 'grenade stuns on every Alpha dive', which is the wrong instruction. (2) Meditate is a 10s channel that heals him and cuts damage taken; a stun cancels it outright, so the grenade's highest-value use in this lane is on his heal, not his engage. (3) Highlander makes him immune to every slow you own — the beams' slow, the grenade's outer slow and a Rylai's all stop working, so the CENTRE stun is the only thing that holds him. None of this was on the page.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[2], whys[4], spikes[0], spikes[1], the new spikes[3], early, mid, late, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[2].
